headline: Proxy and implementation both verified; ChainSecurity audit exists but is 15+ months stale without confirmed re-audit or drift check

findings.text: Proxy 0xBc65ad17c5C0a2A4D159fa5a503f4992c7B545FE is verified on Etherscan (abiSource='etherscan'). Implementation 0xf943Cb8D5f06f2bBF352878ebEF3Ec5C537A20bA is verified via Sourcify (abiSource='sourcify'). SPK token 0xc20059e0317DE91738d13af027DfC4a50781b066 is verified on Etherscan (non-proxy, no implementation required). All three assessed addresses have verified source code.

Public GitHub repo sparkdotfi/spark-vaults exists and describes the UsdcVault (UUPS proxy, ERC-4626, PSM+sUSDS integration) consistent with the ABI shape observed on-chain (UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION=5.0.0, upgradeToAndCall, chi/rho/ssr/psm/susds getters). No deploy-commit SHA was pinned this run — recorded in unknowns[].

ChainSecurity audit 'Code Assessment of the Spark Vaults Smart Contracts' dated January 24, 2025, covers src/UsdcVault.sol, src/UsdcVaultL2.sol, and deploy scripts. Final audit commit: 34ff49e1f81e4d5bb75a9905a914dcc69642885e (January 23, 2025). Zero critical/high/medium/low findings at publication. Analysis date is May 7, 2026 — approximately 15 months after audit completion. No subsequent follow-up audit was found this run.
ChainSecurity (Decentralized Security AG, Zürich) is a broadly recognized Solidity audit firm explicitly listed in the rubric. The audit was produced for SparkDAO/Phoenix Labs.

The ChainSecurity audit was finalized January 2025. The analysis date is May 2026, a gap of ~15 months. The sUSDC vault is described in Spark docs as a 'legacy V1 vault', suggesting it has been superseded by V2 vaults without necessarily being modified. However, no diff of the deployed sourcify-verified source vs. the final audit commit (34ff49e...) was performed this run, so material drift cannot be ruled out. Recorded in unknowns[] as V5.

The proxy 0xBc65ad17... points to implementation 0xf943Cb8D5f06f2bBF352878ebEF3Ec5C537A20bA (confirmed via getImplementation() on-chain read at block 25045890). The implementation is independently verified via Sourcify (abiSource='sourcify', contract name 'UsdcVault'). Proxy+implementation verification chain is complete.

steelman.red: No recognized-firm audit link was pinned in protocol.audit_links, and Etherscan shows 'No Contract Security Audit Submitted' for the proxy — an outsider without deep search could conclude there is no audit.
steelman.orange: The ChainSecurity audit is 15 months old relative to the analysis date, no confirmed re-audit or post-audit differential review was found this run, and no deploy-commit SHA was pinned to confirm the sourcify-verified source matches the audited commit — leaving open the possibility of unreviewed changes in a fund-custody contract.
steelman.green: Both the proxy and its implementation are verified (via Etherscan and Sourcify respectively), the public GitHub repo sparkdotfi/spark-vaults contains UsdcVault source matching the on-chain ABI exactly, and ChainSecurity — a top-tier firm — delivered a clean audit with zero findings of any severity covering the precise contract in scope.

rationale.verdict: Choosing orange because the ChainSecurity audit is approximately 15 months stale (January 2025 vs. May 2026 analysis date) and no confirmed follow-up audit or differential review was found this run; additionally, no deploy-commit SHA was pinned to verify the sourcify-verified source matches the audited commit `34ff49e1f81e4d5bb75a9905a914dcc69642885e`. While the green steel-man is strong (verified, recognized firm, clean audit, public repo), the staleness gap combined with the unconfirmed drift check tips the grade to orange per the rubric's requirement of ≤6 months of drift or a re-audited delta.

evidence.shows: Proxy 0xBc65ad17... verified on Etherscan (abiSource='etherscan'), identified as 'UsdcVault', points to implementation 0xf943Cb8D5f06f2bBF352878ebEF3Ec5C537A20bA. On-chain reads at block 25045890 confirm UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION=5.0.0, asset=USDC, psm, susds, chi, rho, ssr methods all returning live values.

Implementation 0xf943Cb8D5f06f2bBF352878ebEF3Ec5C537A20bA verified via Sourcify (abiSource='sourcify'), identified as 'UsdcVault'. getImplementation() returns zero address confirming this is the implementation (not a further proxy). proxiableUUID() returns the EIP-1967 slot hash confirming UUPS pattern.
SPK token 0xc20059e0... verified on Etherscan (abiSource='etherscan'), non-proxy, symbol='SPK', name='Spark', deploymentChainId=1, totalSupply=10,000,000,000 SPK. No proxy implementation needed.

ChainSecurity audit dated January 24, 2025, for SparkDAO Spark Vaults. Scope: src/UsdcVault.sol, src/UsdcVaultL2.sol, deploy scripts. Final commit: 34ff49e1f81e4d5bb75a9905a914dcc69642885e (Jan 23, 2025). Zero critical/high/medium/low findings; 2 informational items corrected. Covers UUPS upgradeability, functional correctness, vault asset security.

Public GitHub repository for Spark Vaults (V1). Describes UsdcVault using ERC-1822 UUPS pattern and ERC-1967 proxy storage, wrapping PSM+sUSDS interactions. Contract structure and functionality matches on-chain ABI (deposit, redeem, chi/rho/ssr/psm/susds getters, exit hatch). L2 version (UsdcVaultL2) also present.

ChainSecurity landing page for Spark Vaults audit. Confirms auditor is ChainSecurity (Decentralized Security AG, Zürich), scope is SparkDAO ERC-4626 USDC Vault. Provides download link to PDF report. ChainSecurity is a broadly recognized Solidity auditor.

Spark docs describe sUSDC (0xBc65ad17...) as a 'legacy V1 vault' that deposits USDC into the Sky Savings Rate. Users are encouraged to migrate to V2 vaults. This context is relevant to V5 drift assessment — the vault is not being actively developed.

unknowns: V2: Deploy-commit SHA not pinned this run — did not fetch the spark-vaults repo's deployed-addresses JSON or tag to confirm exact commit of deployed bytecode; source-to-repo correspondence is structural/functional match only.

V5: Diff between audited commit 34ff49e1... (Jan 23, 2025) and current sourcify-verified source not performed this run; cannot rule out material post-audit drift in the 15-month window (Jan 2025 to May 2026) for the fund-custody UsdcVault contract.

V3-offchain: No follow-up or differential audit for Spark Vaults V1 (sUSDC) found after the January 2025 ChainSecurity engagement; Etherscan shows 'No Contract Security Audit Submitted' via its own submission system (not the same as absence of external audits).

protocol_metadata.about: Spark Savings allows users to deposit USDC into the Spark USDC Vault (sUSDC), an ERC-4626 compliant contract that wraps interactions with the Sky PSM and Savings USDS (sUSDS) to earn the Sky Savings Rate. Users receive non-rebasing sUSDC shares that increase in value as yield accrues; shares can be redeemed for USDC at any time via the PSM. The vault uses a UUPS upgradeable proxy pattern, with upgrade authority restricted to addresses holding the 'ward' role (expected to be the Spark Governance PauseProxy). The sUSDC vault is designated a legacy V1 product alongside newer V2 vaults (spUSDC, spUSDT, spETH) that route through the Spark Liquidity Layer.
